name: Thaumaturgy — Basic — Repel the Angry Dead

system.description:
The vampire can banish a hostile ghost from a designated area, such as the home of one of the wraith's relatives. In some cases the banishment is only temporary, or requires performing some further action to appease the ghost.

System: The vampire must first locate the angry wraith using See the Dead, then spend a blood point and roll Willpower. The successes determine the number of hours the banished ghost remains away from the location. A second Willpower roll (difficulty 8) lets the vampire learn, with a single success, what would be needed to ensure the ghost's permanent removal.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
